title: Self-Care Night In Gift Ideas for Women
label: Self-Care Night In
intro: The best self-care gift is permission to do nothing for one night. Put it in a basket: a bath soak, a bamboo tub tray, a satin robe, a cooling eye mask, a sheet mask set and a bath pillow. She will say it is too much. She will use every piece by Sunday.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on cream of a bamboo bathtub tray, bath soak, pink satin robe, cooling eye mask, sheet masks, a silicone face scrubber and a pink bath pillow.
Chin-down crop of a woman in a pink satin robe on the edge of a clawfoot tub in a farmhouse bathroom, swirling bath soak, bamboo tray, candles and a pink bath pillow.
